_comment: The Phase 1 course. It is deliberately NOT a throwaway placeholder: catalog_sync is get-or-create with no reconciliation pass, so a course it creates stays in Moodle with its enrolments forever — a 'TEST COURSE' would be permanent clutter. This is the real first course (see docs/professor-adow-tvet-setup-plan.md, Phase 3), declared with its units PLANNED and none of them BUILT. The generator lists a unit only when its data file exists, so today this ships a real course with zero grade items, which is exactly the empty-school probe Phase 1 wants.
title: Solar Photovoltaic Installation & Maintenance
_level: TVET has levels, not grades. levelKind is carried end to end precisely so nothing downstream reads levelNumber as a school year — the trap Intensive English fell into by sending its CEFR level as `grade`, which is why WEHEL_INTENSIVE_BANDS exists as a separate table. See the plan doc.
summary: Sizing, installing, testing and maintaining standalone solar photovoltaic systems. Theory, calculation and fault-finding are studied online; installation and testing competencies are assessed at the centre workshop.
_progressPartition: Which partition the catalogue's `units` array — and therefore the Moodle grade items — represents. catalog_sync names every grade item `Progress: uNN` from unit.number, so whatever is listed here IS the progress partition and nothing else may claim it. A TVET course has three plausible partitions (modules, units of competency, assessment events); this course uses units of competency.
_units: `data` is relative to this file. A unit joins the catalogue — and gets a grade item — on the day its JSON ships, not before. `assessmentMode` records whether the platform can assess the unit at all (knowledge | practical | both); it is the field that keeps a blended school honest about what it certifies. These titles are a first pass and are NOT trade-reviewed — Phase 2 replaces them from the occupational standards file.
